mechanism: Triamcinolone (corticosteroid) promotes sodium retention and potassium loss, while captopril (ACE inhibitor) promotes potassium retention, creating opposing electrolyte effects and increased hyperkalemia risk; corticosteroids also reduce antihypertensive efficacy of ACE inhibitors.
action: Monitor serum potassium, sodium, and renal function regularly; use lowest effective corticosteroid dose and shortest duration; consider potassium-sparing alternatives or dietary potassium restriction; monitor blood pressure control.
